resource: Unsettled creature kill reward entries per Channel (queued plus in flight)
allocation_impact: Checked when a lethal creature death is appended, under the Channel attack guard; the 65th unsettled entry is not queued, settles nothing and logs one kill_reward_refused reason=queue_full line. Each entry holds the projected death facts, an Arc of the immutable reward row and the death ground context; no entry is allocated past the bound.
boundary_tests: max=64: 63 queued plus 1 in flight are all held
max+1=65: the 65th unsettled death is refused with queue_full while one is in flight
